derivation: Simple Tools sells nothing: the Death Vault is a crafted block, the Soulbound book comes only from the wandering trader (diamonds) and End City loot (owner 2026-10-12). Money bills count as Death Vault offerings through the optional tag simpletools:death_vault_offerings.

excluded.simpletools:death_vault: Crafted only (KONZEPT-DEATH-VAULT, owner 2026-10-12); bills are accepted as offerings instead.
excluded.simpletools:guide_book: Crafted from a book and an anvil.
